short: Theta lifting between definite unitary groups

lean.name: UpperTheory.TP.TLiftK
lean.plain: Theta lifting between definite unitary groups
lean.note: The theta-lift hypothesis concerns pairs of definite unitary groups, with Hermitian source and skew-Hermitian target. Once the target rank is large enough, the lift is supplied for source representations satisfying the required weight inequality at each infinite place.
